description:
Collections are copied to iterate where nothing conflicts.

Evidence (develop @ cca160808):
- src/compiler2/ordered_set.rs:90 implements IntoIterator for &OrderedSet
  only. Two callers hold a set they are about to drop and still clone every
  element: scheduler.rs:1182 `woken.iter().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>()`,
  world.rs:2951 dedupe_job_facts
  `facts.into_iter().collect::<OrderedSet<_>>().iter().cloned().collect()`.
- src/compiler2/jobs/native.rs:4701
  `neighbors.iter().copied().collect::<Vec<_>>()` in strongconnect; `graph`
  is `&HashMap<FnId, HashSet<FnId>>` and is never mutated in the recursion.
- src/compiler2/native_codegen/driver.rs:642
  `for (..) in mid_flight_cont_tail_fn_ids.clone()` -- clones the whole
  &HashMap argument (keys hold Vec<MidFlightArgShape>) for a `move` closure
  that only calls arg_shapes.iter().

Change: OrderedSet gets an owned IntoIterator; the two callers consume the
set. strongconnect iterates `neighbors` directly. The driver loop iterates
the map by reference. Before building: check emit_fn_body's closure bound
(a 'static bound would make the driver clone necessary; record it if so).

Removal ledger: the four copies above.

Signal: gate green, no golden/census/pin movement. Iteration order of the
consumed OrderedSet must equal its borrowed iteration order.
title: OrderedSet is consumed by value; iteration copies nothing it does not need
